**Schedule sizing when shortcut recording starts.** `startRecording` changes an empty editor’s placeholder to `Press shortcut…`, but the sizing family schedules only on shortcut `textChanged`, font, show, and resize events. The width pass can therefore retain the width measured for `Not set` and clip the recording prompt when all shortcuts are empty. Schedule a sizing pass when recording changes the placeholder, or reserve the recording prompt width.
